== Summary ==
Three of the four winners of the [[DecipherCon 1999 Team Event]], Star Wars CCG team event at [[DecipherCon 1999]]: [[Martin Akesson]], [[Koen Meijssen]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]]. [[Paul Todd Feldman]] is not in the photo. Photo: Decipher.

Decipher's 50×38 index thumbnail. The Wayback Machine holds no copy of the full-size sun24.jpg.
